name: HOMIO Frontend Implementation Blueprint

authority.this_file_is: Frontend implementation contract, dependency map, backend capability binding map, architecture-control registry, artifact registry, verification registry and frontend history
this_file_is_not: a second business source of truth

product.name: HOMIO
product.identity: Global AI Real Estate OS + International Brokerage + SaaS
product.frontend_role: Global customer, professional and transaction experience layer
product.north_star: A customer gives HOMIO one real-estate problem; HOMIO finds, verifies, matches, communicates, protects, negotiates and coordinates the right opportunity through a governed transaction.
product.experience_principle: The frontend exposes HOMIO capabilities; REOS owns domain truth; ACRL protects build-time continuity and verification.

non_negotiable_rules: No generic property-portal clone.
No India-only visual or business assumptions.
No hardcoded INR-first product model.
No duplicate search engine.
No duplicate matching engine.
No duplicate trust engine.
No duplicate fraud engine.
No duplicate governance engine.
No duplicate lead ownership engine.
No duplicate deal engine.
No duplicate commission engine.
No duplicate AI decision authority.
No duplicate ACRL implementation in the browser.
No giant monolithic index.html as the permanent application architecture.
Business truth comes from existing REOS contracts.
Derived frontend state must never silently become canonical business truth.
New functionality must be modular and replaceable.
Every implementation batch must have machine-readable evidence.
Every completed frontend task must record files changed and verification performed.
Chat history must not be required to reconstruct frontend progress.
Canonical graph ownership remains in HOMIO_REOS_MASTER_ARCHITECTURE.json.
Frontend must bind every business-facing experience to an identified REOS or ARCH authority.
Frontend may display intelligence, recommendations and digital twins but cannot promote derived views to canonical truth.
Frontend must preserve provenance and freshness context whenever authoritative services expose it.
Frontend must not independently ingest, normalize, license, retain or govern external business data.
AI suggestions and next-best-action proposals remain advisory until an authoritative governed action boundary is invoked.
High-risk or irreversible frontend actions must use explicit authorization and approval states from REOS.
Frontend architecture changes cannot introduce a new top-level business domain or autonomous authority.
Frontend route and module design must remain compatible with global multi-tenant and international brokerage boundaries.
Frontend dependency design must prefer existing CORE and ARCH capabilities over local reimplementation.
Frontend cache and derived presentation state must be discardable and reconstructable from authoritative contracts or events.

current_repository_boundary.reason: The existing frontend contains a monolithic/static implementation and must be replaced by the modular implementation defined by this blueprint.

reos_dependencies.backend_execution_rule: Frontend must not assume a backend capability is runtime-live merely because its architecture node exists. Runtime integration requires the corresponding Control Center state/gate and a verified contract.

runtime_readiness.CORE-008: commission/financial consumer contract required; implementation remains backend-owned and authoritative

acrl_usage.role: Build-time continuity, repository intelligence, dependency analysis, safe execution, verification, recovery and handoff.

architecture_layers.name: Frontend Authority & Repository Foundation
architecture_layers.goal: Create the permanent frontend boundary and implementation registry.
tasks: F01-T01 Define frontend root and ownership boundary
F01-T03 Define frontend artifact naming convention
acceptance: Frontend has one canonical repository boundary.
Frontend does not own backend business truth.
Frontend does not duplicate REOS engines.
Frontend implementation can be reconstructed without chat history.

architecture_layers.name: HOMIO Global Design System
architecture_layers.goal: Create the permanent visual language instead of page-specific styling.
acceptance: No page-specific design token duplication.
Desktop, tablet and mobile rules are defined.
Accessibility is built into primitives.
Visual changes can be made centrally.

architecture_layers.name: Global Application Shell
architecture_layers.goal: Create the reusable HOMIO application shell.
acceptance: Every future page uses the same shell.
Mobile navigation works without layout breakage.
Loading/error/empty states are reusable.

architecture_layers.name: Global HOMIO Home Experience
architecture_layers.goal: Build the premium global landing experience.
acceptance: Homepage clearly communicates global rather than India-first positioning.
The page is usable on desktop, tablet and mobile.
City expansion is configuration-driven.
Search interaction is connected to the REOS adapter boundary.
No business matching logic lives inside homepage code.

architecture_layers.name: Global Market Experience
architecture_layers.goal: Make country/city discovery a first-class global experience.
acceptance: New markets are added by data/configuration where possible.
Market-specific localization does not fork the application.

architecture_layers.name: Search & Matching Experience
architecture_layers.goal: Expose CORE-005 through an advanced user-friendly discovery experience.
acceptance: Search UI delegates actual matching/ranking to CORE-005.
Search state can be reproduced.
Match explanations are explainable and source-driven.
No second ranking/matching algorithm exists in frontend.

architecture_layers.name: Property / Project / Inventory Experience
architecture_layers.goal: Expose CORE-004 inventory truth through premium property and project experiences.
acceptance: Inventory truth is read from REOS.
Availability cannot be silently invented by frontend.
Property/project/unit context remains unambiguous.

architecture_layers.name: Identity, Customer & My HOMIO Journey
architecture_layers.goal: Create the customer account and journey layer.
acceptance: Identity and session state come from CORE-001.
Lead ownership comes from CORE-003.
Frontend never silently changes lead ownership.
Customer journey can be reconstructed.

architecture_layers.name: Communication & AI Experience
architecture_layers.goal: Expose approved communication and AI capabilities without creating a second AI system.
acceptance: AI remains advisory/governed according to REOS.
Frontend does not become final business decision authority.
Human approval states are visible where required.

architecture_layers.name: Deal Room & Transaction Experience
acceptance: Deal state comes from CORE-006.
Commission logic is not duplicated.
Trust/fraud/governance remain external authorities.
Historical deal truth remains auditable.

architecture_layers.name: Professional & Operating-Mode Experience
architecture_layers.goal: Create broker, builder, enterprise and partner surfaces without creating separate products.
acceptance: Operating modes do not fork business logic.
Permissions are enforced through existing identity/tenant authority.
Professional experiences compose existing CORE capabilities.

architecture_layers.name: Globalization, SEO, Accessibility, Performance & Security
acceptance: Global markets work without country-specific forks.
Accessibility is validated.
SEO is systematic rather than page-by-page improvisation.
Performance budgets are measurable.
Privacy/security boundaries are explicit.

architecture_layers.name: REOS Integration, Production Hardening & Adversarial Regression
architecture_layers.goal: Turn the frontend from presentation-ready into a production REOS consumer.
acceptance: Frontend consumes authoritative REOS services.
No duplicate domain responsibility remains.
Tenant isolation is preserved.
High-risk actions respect authorization boundaries.
Frontend passes targeted and full regression.
Production deployment is repeatable.
Frontend can be reconstructed and verified without chat history.

per_batch: Read current canonical state before implementation.
Record implementation status in this blueprint.
Checkpoint through existing Control Center/ACRL workflow where applicable.

status_registry.next_authoritative_project_step_rule: After the blueprint is persisted, the next frontend implementation action must still be reconciled against REOS_CONTROL_CENTER/data/state.json and the active Control Center gate/subtask. This file defines frontend scope, dependency and verification rules only; it cannot invent a competing execution roadmap.

required.purpose: Frontend implementation contract and progress registry

history_registry.rule: Every completed implementation batch must append one immutable history entry.

requires_architecture_review: change to international brokerage operating boundary

definition_of_done: All required frontend phases are machine-tracked.
Every completed task has file evidence.
Every completed task has verification evidence.
No completed task depends on chat memory.
No frontend module owns forbidden business truth.
REOS contracts are used rather than duplicated.
ACRL remains the build-time continuity and verification boundary.
Global localization is operational.
Responsive behavior is validated.
Accessibility is validated.
Search and matching are connected to CORE-005.
Inventory is connected to CORE-004.
Lead ownership is connected to CORE-003.
Deal workflows are connected to CORE-006.
Trust/governance are connected to CORE-007.
Financial/commission surfaces are connected to CORE-008.
Canonical graph bindings are documented.
Backend capability ownership is documented.
API/service/event/security authorities are documented.
Frontend state ownership is documented.
Derived frontend state remains rebuildable.
External data provenance boundaries are preserved.
Production hardening and adversarial regression pass.
Final frontend evidence is recorded.

change_log.summary: Created the frontend implementation blueprint so frontend architecture, future scope, status, artifacts, verification and history do not depend on chat memory.

Aligned the frontend implementation blueprint with HOMIO_REOS_MASTER_ARCHITECTURE.json by binding canonical graphs, backend capability ownership, API/service/event/security authority, derived-system guardrails, global multi-tenant rules, international brokerage boundaries and permanent frontend architecture controls.

master_architecture_alignment.reconciliation_rule: The frontend follows the canonical architecture content and Control Center execution state. This blueprint must never silently promote, reinterpret or resolve an architecture-state discrepancy.
master_architecture_alignment.architecture_node_rule: Frontend consumes capabilities exposed by architecture nodes; it does not create, replace or modify architecture nodes.

canonical_graph_bindings.name: Demand Graph
canonical_graph_bindings.purpose: Demand, intent, attribution and genuine-lead intelligence
canonical_graph_bindings.truth_rule: Frontend renders authoritative demand outputs; it does not own demand truth.

canonical_graph_bindings.name: Inventory Graph
canonical_graph_bindings.purpose: Builder, project, phase, tower, floor, unit, availability, price and verification
canonical_graph_bindings.truth_rule: Frontend reads inventory truth from REOS and never invents availability or canonical pricing.

canonical_graph_bindings.name: Relationship Graph
canonical_graph_bindings.purpose: Customer, HOMIO/broker, builder, project and unit relationship protection
canonical_graph_bindings.truth_rule: Relationship and ownership authority remains in REOS.

canonical_graph_bindings.name: Transaction Graph
canonical_graph_bindings.purpose: Lead to qualification to visit to offer to booking to completion
canonical_graph_bindings.truth_rule: Frontend presents transaction state; it does not authoritatively advance transaction state without governed backend action.

canonical_graph_bindings.name: Evidence Graph
canonical_graph_bindings.purpose: Events, consent, attribution, audit and dispute-grade proof
canonical_graph_bindings.truth_rule: Frontend displays and submits evidence through authoritative REOS boundaries; it is not evidence authority.

canonical_graph_bindings.name: Intelligence Graph
canonical_graph_bindings.purpose: Market, demand, inventory, conversion, pricing and outcome intelligence
canonical_graph_bindings.truth_rule: Intelligence is derived/advisory and cannot silently become business truth.

demand_acquisition_mesh.rule: Frontend renders acquisition/discovery experiences and consumes results; acquisition logic and attribution remain backend-owned.

opportunity_radar.rule: Signals and recommendations shown by frontend are not canonical truth.

demand_to_inventory_gap_engine.rule: Frontend presents qualified demand-gap outputs and acquisition candidates returned by REOS.

builder_acquisition_intelligence.rule: Frontend cannot create commercial commitment authority.

broker_chief_of_staff.rule: Frontend is an interaction surface only; approval and authority remain governed by REOS.

deal_digital_twin.rule: Frontend may display the digital twin but must never promote it to canonical deal truth.

continuous_learning_loop.rule: Frontend outcomes/telemetry may feed approved intelligence pipelines; historical truth is never rewritten.

external_data_governance.rule: Frontend does not independently ingest, normalize, license, retain or govern external data.

backend_runtime_contract.runtime_rule: Frontend consumes verified contracts and events and renders governed states. It does not recreate service, event, security, AI, tenant, relationship, commission or operating-mode engines.

derived_system_guardrails.rebuildability_rule: Frontend caches and derived presentation state must be discardable and reconstructable from authoritative contracts/events.
derived_system_guardrails.historical_truth_rule: Frontend never rewrites historical business truth.
derived_system_guardrails.cache_rule: Cache invalidation or refresh never changes canonical business state.
derived_system_guardrails.stale_data_rule: Stale or uncertain derived data must be visually distinguishable when authoritative freshness metadata exists.

architecture_controls.rule: These controls govern frontend implementation without creating a second architecture or roadmap.

controls.name: Authority & Boundary Rules
controls.purpose: Prevent frontend ownership of backend business truth
rules: Architecture changes require existing architecture review

controls.name: API Contract Registry
controls.rule: A business-facing module is not production-ready until its authoritative integration contract is identified.

controls.name: State Ownership Model
controls.purpose: Prevent UI state from becoming business state
controls.rule: Only authoritative REOS responses/events may establish canonical business state.

controls.name: Design System Governance
controls.rule: Feature modules consume shared design-system primitives rather than creating local design languages.

controls.name: Module Dependency Governance
controls.purpose: Prevent circular or duplicate frontend responsibilities
rules: Experience modules depend on shared primitives/integration adapters
Integration adapters depend on contracts, not feature presentation
Shared modules cannot import feature-owned business logic
Business authority is never implemented inside a presentation component

controls.name: Environment & Release Controls
controls.purpose: Keep runtime configuration separate from source code
controls.rule: Production endpoints/secrets must not be hardcoded in frontend source.

controls.name: Failure & Recovery Model
controls.rule: Failure states must preserve user context and must not fabricate missing business truth.

controls.name: Security & Privacy Boundary
controls.purpose: Protect tenant and user data at presentation/runtime boundaries
controls.rule: Security decisions remain authoritative in REOS; frontend must enforce presentation/interaction boundaries and never weaken backend authorization.

controls.name: Observability & Evidence Contract
controls.rule: Frontend telemetry supports diagnosis and workflow visibility; authoritative evidence remains owned by REOS.

controls.name: Migration & Deprecation Control
controls.purpose: Prevent prototype/legacy functionality from silently remaining production paths
controls.rule: Deprecated routes/components must have an explicit migration or removal record.

frontend_contract_model.route_rule: Routes are experience entry points, not business authority boundaries.
frontend_contract_model.component_rule: Components are presentation/interaction units, not domain engines.
frontend_contract_model.adapter_rule: Integration adapters normalize transport only; they do not reproduce business decisions.
frontend_contract_model.event_rule: UI refresh triggered by events must consume authoritative event-derived state rather than mutate business truth locally.
